question: Kannst du mir bitte helfen? Wo finde ich den offiziellen Schweizer Fahrplandatensatz 2026, und welchen Zeitraum deckt er ab?
reference_answer: The official 2026 Swiss public transport timetable dataset is published on opentransportdata.swiss in GTFS format. It covers 14 December 2025 through 12 December 2026. The dataset is published by the SKI business office on behalf of the Federal Office of Transport (FOT).
common_errors: Presents the 2026 dataset as covering the whole calendar year
Confuses the timetable data with real-time updates
authority: Customer Information System Tasks (SKI) business office, on behalf of the Federal Office of Transport (FOT)
evidence: Temporal coverage: December 14, 2025 - December 12, 2026. The timetable is provided in the General Transit Feed Specification Format (GTFS). Working on behalf of the Swiss Federal Office of Transport (FOT), the Customer Information System Tasks (SKI) business office publishes data on all public transport in Switzerland.

question: Pouvez-vous m'aider ? Les données GTFS statiques des transports publics suisses indiquent-elles les retards en temps réel ?
reference_answer: No. GTFS Static describes planned timetable data and does not provide real-time information such as delays. opentransportdata.swiss provides GTFS Realtime separately for real-time information.

must_include.fact: GTFS Static is planned/static timetable data

must_not_include.reason: Incorrectly claims static GTFS includes real-time delays

common_errors: Says the static feed contains live delays
Treats service alerts and timetable schedules as the same data
Claims the Swiss dataset has no real-time data at all
authority: Customer Information System Tasks (SKI) business office / opentransportdata.swiss
evidence: A GTFS static file contains all public transport in Switzerland in a public transport timetable year (365 days from mid-December). Unlike GTFS Realtime (GTFS-RT), GTFS Static provides only static data, not real-time data.

question: Può aiutarmi? Con quale frequenza viene aggiornato il dataset ufficiale dell'orario svizzero 2026 su opentransportdata.swiss?
reference_answer: The 2026 timetable dataset is updated twice a week. The dataset page cautions that updates are not made on public holidays.

question: Kannst du mir bitte helfen? Wie lange deckt ein Schweizer statischer GTFS-Fahrplan ab?
reference_answer: Ein GTFS-Static-Datensatz deckt ein Fahrplanjahr des öffentlichen Verkehrs ab, also 365 Tage ab Mitte Dezember.
common_errors: Confuses a timetable year with the calendar year or realtime feed.
authority: SKI-Geschäftsstelle im Auftrag des Bundesamts für Verkehr (BAV)
evidence: In einer GTFS-Static-Datei ist der gesamte öffentliche Verkehr der Schweiz eines Fahrplanjahrs des öffentlichen Verkehrs (365 Tage ab Mitte Dezember) enthalten.
